instructions: Thinly slice the apples, about 1/4 inch thick. Thinly slice the cheddar.
Lay out the 8 bread slices and spread 1/4 cup of honey mustard thinly across all of them.
On 4 of the slices, layer half an apple and 2 oz of the cheese, then top each with another slice, mustard side down.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium and coat it lightly with cooking spray. Cook 2 sandwiches at a time, pressing down on them with a second heavy pan or a spatula.
Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, flipping once halfway, until the bread is toasted and the cheese has melted. Repeat with the other 2 sandwiches.
Let each sandwich cool for 1 minute before cutting.
method_notes: Food.com's version (12 reviews, no star rating shown, so the fallback applies) spreads honey mustard on whole grain bread, layers apple and mild cheddar, and grills each sandwich 3 to 5 minutes in a press or under a second heavy skillet. Apples from NY has the same recipe with low-fat cheddar. Homemade Nutrition's single-serving version adds spinach and pepper, which this one leaves out.
